FAQsPage.title: FAQs
FAQsPage.description: Frequently Asked Questions about Indowud NFC.

questions.q: Can nfc board be used for exterior flooring / decking applications?
questions.a: Use Indowud NFC Build, 26mm Board for decking and flooring. Ensure proper support as per guidelines for installation. Apply a sealant to close pores, followed by primer, paint/varnish, and an anti-scratch coating for durability and protection. Regular maintenance and reapplication of protective layers are recommended.

questions.q: Where should the use of nfc board be avoided?
questions.a: Nfc boards are suitable for all exterior and interior applications. However, the use of nfc board must be avoided in all those places where the temperature is above 60 degree Celsius.

questions.q: Can nfc board be fixed directly on the wall?
questions.a: We do not recommend fixing nfc boards directly on the wall. It is recommended to leave a gap of atleast 10mm from the wall and fix the boards on the support/frame provided. Refer to guidelines and suggestions for more details or download the technical brochure from the downloads page in our website.

questions.q: Can nfc board be used for ceiling applications?
questions.a: Indowud nfc can be used for ceiling applications. It is suggested to reduce the thickness wise recommended support distance by 100mm to avoid gravitational pull.

questions.q: Does nfc deform without providing proper support?
questions.a: Yes, nfc boards are homogeneous product. Hence, it requires a proper constructive/structural support to avoid unwanted deformations.

questions.q: Can nfc boards be used for exterior applications?
questions.a: Yes, nfc boards are 100% water proof and can be used for all types of exterior applications. It is recommended to apply sealant/varnish/coating/paint of exterior grade to protect the boards from sun/weather and regular wear & tear.

questions.q: Can nfc board deform during climatic changes or extreme weather?
questions.a: If we take care of proper support system, type of screws used, and exterior grade sealant/varnishing/painting/coating, the boards would resist deformations.

questions.q: How does nfc board be fire retardant and smoke suppressant?
questions.a: During the manufacturing process, certain additives are used that prevents the spread of fire and smoke in the unlikely event of fire accident. Indowud nfc has been tested with UL94 of USA (V0 rating) and ASTM E84 (passes class 1/a. Flame spread index @ 6 and smoke developed index @ 100) and UIC564 (Class 1/a).

questions.q: Is nfc free from harmful ingredients?
questions.a: Yes, Indowud nfc is RoHS certified and has ensured that it is free from asbestos, lead and other harmful raw materials.

questions.q: Does nfc board emit harmful VOC gases?
questions.a: No, There are no harmful VOC gases emitting from nfc boards making it a safe option to be used for all types of interior applications.

questions.q: Can I use regular wood working tools as nfc board working cum finish work cutter?
questions.a: Yes, the boards can be processed like any other wood based panel products and all types of wood working tools can be used for processing.

questions.q: Do we need a substrate to paste on indowud nfc before PU painting
questions.a: No, it is possible to PU paint directly on Indowud nfc. Do not use NC Putty. Do not pour water before closure of pores. Please contact us for more details.

questions.q: What are the glues suggested to use on nfc board?
questions.a: NFC-GLU, Probond, WP1, HeatX, PUR, Plastilok can be used. However, for any other adhesives, it is suggested to test the adhesive with a small sample piece of Indowud nfc. Drying time may vary due to environmental and atmospheric conditions.

questions.q: If fixing distances are too wide, can nfc vibrate?
questions.a: Unwanted deformations may appear if recommended fixing distance is not followed. We suggest to follow the recommended fixing distance for best results and to avoid curve generation.

questions.q: Does the company offer any buyback of nfc boards?
questions.a: Yes, Indowud offers buy back of nfc boards. Ensure that the boards are free from metal and wood parts before sending the wastage/scrap/rejected boards to the factory for recycling. Please contact us for more details.

questions.q: Is there a warranty that comes with nfc board?
questions.a: Yes, Indowud nfc offers a warranty. Refer to the warranty page for more details about the warranty.

questions.q: Can indowud panels be customized?
questions.a: Yes, Indowud panels can be customized in terms of size, finish, and design to suit various project requirements.

questions.q: How does using indowud contribute to eco-friendly construction?
questions.a: Indowud helps reduce reliance on wood, preserving forests and lowering carbon footprints in construction projects.

questions.q: What is nfc board?
questions.a: Nfc means Natural Fibre Composite product. It is a sustainable ecofriendly board that looks, feels and are available in dimensions like wood based panels for all exterior and interior applications.

questions.q: What are the standard nfc Board sizes available?
questions.a: Nfc boards are available in the standard size of 8 feet (2440mm) x 4 feet (1220mm) x thickness : 6mm, 8mm, 12mm, 15mm, 16mm, 18mm, 20mm, 25mm. However, customized sizes are available as per the request. Please contact us for the available options.

questions.q: Is nfc eco-conscious?
questions.a: Yes, Indowud nfc is a zero wood product made using agricultural husks primarily and extruded. Our product is certified with GreePro ecolabel by the CII (Confederation of Indian Industries) – Green Products and Services Council (CII – GPSC) / CII- Godrej IGBC.

questions.q: What is GreenPro ecolabel?
questions.a: GreenPro is a Type-1 Ecolabel that helps the building and manufacturing sectors choose sustainable products, materials, and technologies to reduce environmental impact. Products with the GreenPro Ecolabel, like Indowud, have lower environmental footprints and contribute to improving the performance of Green Buildings and eco-friendly companies. As a zero-wood, durable, and termite-resistant WPC alternative, Indowud supports sustainable construction and interior solutions.

questions.q: Is there any colour options in nfc?
questions.a: Indowud nfc is available in standard wood like brown colour. However, it is easy to paint and stain nfc board as per the desired colour.

questions.q: What makes indowud a superior alternative to traditional wood-based panels?
questions.a: Indowud is eco-friendly, durable, termite-proof, and moisture-resistant. It is a zero-wood product, offering a sustainable alternative to plywood and MDF.

questions.q: How is indowud contributing to environmental sustainability?
questions.a: Indowud uses zero wood, helping to reduce deforestation. It’s made from recycled materials and supports eco-friendly construction practices.

questions.q: Is indowud suitable for both interior and exterior applications?
questions.a: Yes, Indowud is versatile and can be used for both interior and exterior furnishings, offering resistance to weather, moisture, and insects.

questions.q: Can indowud be customised for specific design needs?
questions.a: Yes, Indowud can be easily cut, shaped, and finished, making it customizable for various design and architectural requirements.

questions.q: What is Indowud NFC?
questions.a: Indowud NFC is a sustainable, zero-wood panel product designed for both interior and exterior furnishings, offering an eco-friendly alternative to plywood and MDF.

questions.q: Is indowud resistant to pests and moisture?
questions.a: Yes, Indowud is highly resistant to pests, moisture, and rot, making it long-lasting and low-maintenance.

questions.q: Is indowud easy to install?
questions.a: Yes, Indowud is designed for easy installation with traditional woodworking tools.

questions.q: Does indowud require special maintenance?
questions.a: No, Indowud is low-maintenance. It’s resistant to moisture and pests, so routine cleaning is typically all that’s needed.

questions.q: What is WPC Plywood Board?
questions.a: WPC boards blend wood fibers and plastic, offering water resistance, durability, and termite-proof features. Unlike WPC, Indowud uses zero wood, ensuring superior eco-friendliness, strength, and sustainability.

questions.q: Which is better, PVC or WPC?
questions.a: WPC boards, like Indowud, offer better durability, water resistance, and eco-friendliness than PVC. While PVC is cheaper, Indowud — a zero-wood, sustainable WPC alternative — is termite-resistant, long-lasting, and ideal for furniture, interiors, and outdoor applications.

questions.q: Which material is good for room partition?
questions.a: Indowud Jalli is an eco-friendly, zero-wood composite panel with a unique jalli texture. It’s durable, sustainable, and perfect for interior and exterior applications, offering both aesthetic appeal and strength.

questions.q: What are the benefits of NFC flutes wall panel?
questions.a: Indowud NFC flutes wall panels are lightweight, durable, and eco-friendly. They offer excellent sound insulation, thermal resistance, easy installation, and aesthetic appeal, making them ideal for modern, sustainable interior designs.

questions.q: How long does fire-retardant plywood last?
questions.a: Fire-retardant plywood typically lasts 10-25 years, depending on environmental conditions. However, Indowud offers a superior alternative with its zero-wood, fire-retardant panels, which have lifelong durability and enhanced resistance to fire, moisture, and termites. Unlike traditional plywood, Indowud does not degrade over time, making it a more sustainable and long-lasting choice for both interior and exterior applications.

questions.q: What are WPC boards used for?
questions.a: WPC boards are used for furniture, wall cladding, doors, and outdoor decking. Indowud offers a superior zero-wood WPC, making it more durable, waterproof, and eco-friendly

questions.q: Are WPC boards waterproof?
questions.a: Yes, WPC boards are waterproof, perfect for kitchens, bathrooms, and outdoor spaces. Indowud, a zero-wood, eco-friendly WPC alternative, is durable, termite-proof, and moisture-resistant — a sustainable, long-lasting choice for interiors and exteriors.

questions.q: Which board is termite-proof?
questions.a: WPC boards are termite-proof, making them a durable and low-maintenance choice for homes and commercial spaces. Eco-friendly alternatives like Indowud, a zero-wood WPC solution, offer enhanced termite resistance along with moisture and weather protection — perfect for both interiors and exteriors.

ChairmanPage.title: Chairman Message
ChairmanPage.description: A message from our Chairman, Mr. B L Bengani.
ChairmanPage.intro: With over 30 years in the wood panel industry, Mr. Bengani is respected as the founder of Uniply.
ChairmanPage.motto: Quality of product is determined with its performance and customer satisfaction. This is the mantra I follow at Indowud NFC
ChairmanPage.sectionTitle:
Can we build a better tomorrow without cutting down a single tree?
Yes...! We can.
ChairmanPage.para1: When we first began Indowud NFC, the idea was bold - to create a wood alternative that performs better, lasts longer, and protects our environment. Today, that vision has grown far beyond a single product.
ChairmanPage.para2: From an innovative board made from sustainable agricultural husk, Indowud NFC has evolved into a comprehensive range of eco-smart solutions - including boards, frames, ceilings, siding, panelling, decking, and flooring. All proudly made in India. All without cutting a single tree.
ChairmanPage.para3: The range of Indowud NFC products is built with the Ahimsa Design Philosophy - where performance meets purpose. They are waterproof, termite proof, flame retardant, antimicrobial and engineered to withstand nature's harshest elements. But above all, they are created with deep respect and love for nature.
ChairmanPage.para4: At Indowud NFC, we make a promise to our planet - to conserve, not consume; to protect, not pollute. At the same time to deliver top quality products to our customers without costing the planet. That's our promise .

SuggestionsPage.title: Important Suggestions
SuggestionsPage.description: Achieve maintenance-free, zero-defect furniture with our technical guidelines.
SuggestionsPage.videoNote: To achieve a maintenance zero defect furniture, please follow the video mentioning about the working with Indowud nfc.
SuggestionsPage.gridTitle: Indowud nfc is a homogeneous product and hence requires proper constructive grid support (frames, channels, etc made of metal tube) to avoid deformations
SuggestionsPage.gridDescription: Precise grid spacing is critical for structural integrity and preventing surface deformations.

table.header: Thickness of Indowud NFC board (in mm)
table.proTipText: Always verify grid square supports before installation to ensure uniform weight distribution.
table.note: For ceiling, use 12mm or higher thickness board with suggested grid square support of 300mm for create or build and 200mm for neo.

general.title: Sealing & Surface Preparation
general.text: Do not use NC putty. Ensure that solvent/epoxy-based sealer, PU filler is used. Do not pour water on the raw board before closure of the micro pores all around. Ensure that the micro pores at all sides (surface and edge) are closed with epoxy/solvent based sealer/primer.

general.title: Shutters & Mounting
general.text: In order to avoid bowing or deformation, paste veneer/laminate on both sides before fixing shutter. We suggest to cover the edges with a suitable lipping/edge band. Ensure similar panel is pasted on both sides for similar balancing. In case of varnish/polish/PU paint, cover the micro pores with epoxy/solvent sealer and then fix the shutter. Use hinges at every 300-350mm and magnetic ball catch at top and bottom. Use of stiffener/straighter is recommended. For sliding shutters, ensure proper framing on all four sides with necessary stiffeners.

general.title: Adhesives
general.text: NFC-GLU, PUR, Heatx, WP1, Probond, Plastilok, Relam. Drying time may vary depending on atmospheric conditions. For any glue, we advise to test on a small piece before applying on larger panels.

general.title: Expansion Gaps
general.text: Leave min 12mm gap between wall and board for breathing. Leave 5mm gap on ceiling and flooring for breathing and expansion/contraction. Leave a gap of 3 – 5 mm between two boards.

general.title: Fastening & Screwing
general.text: Use wide head, fully threaded, three times long of the board thickness. Gluing at the joinery is suggested for better strength. Screwing should be slow and stop at the surface. Do not hammer and do not pull out the screw.

ceiling.title: Ceiling Beautification Guidelines
ceiling.intro: When using Indowud nfc Boards for ceiling beautification, it is imperative to follow advanced technical guidelines to ensure a secure, durable, and aesthetically superior installation. The following comprehensive recommendations will aid in achieving the best in class results:

items.title: Gravitational Forces
items.text: Recognise and counteract the gravitational forces acting on ceiling-mounted Indowud nfc products.

items.title: Support
items.text: We suggest to use 12mm or higher thickness nfc product with a suggested grid support of 300mm x 300 for create and build and 200mm x 200mm for neo.

items.title: Fastening
items.text: Utilise wide head washer screws to secure the product to the ceiling. These screws offer a larger contact area, distributing the load more evenly and reducing the risk of detachment. Ensure that screws penetrate at least double of the thickness of the boards into the substructure for optimal holding strength.

items.title: Screw Placement
items.text: Place screws at intervals of no more than 300mm along the board edges and 400mm within the field of the boards to provide consistent support and prevent sagging.

items.title: Heat Exposure
items.text: For ceiling applications exposed to direct sunlight, such as open-to-sky installations, the supporting mild steel (MS) substructure can absorb and retain heat, leading to thermal expansion and potential structural compromise.

items.title: Preventive Measures
items.text: Apply a heat-resistant rubber paint coating to the MS substructure. This thermal barrier reduces heat transfer, mitigating thermal expansion and protecting the integrity of the product.

items.title: Thermal Breaks
items.text: Incorporate thermal breaks within the substructure design to minimise heat conduction. Materials such as insulating foam strips or thermal pads can be placed between the metal substructure and the nfc board product.

items.title: Avoiding screw on porous surface
items.text: Avoid fixing screws directly into the grooves or routed porous surface of nfc boards. This can compromise the structural integrity of the product due to porous nature of centre core.

items.title: Trimming and Shaping
items.text: Create a Z-shaped edge on the board's perimeter before installation. This technique enhances alignment, stability, and aesthetic appeal.

items.title: Expansion Gap
items.text: Maintain a gap of 3mm to 6mm between boards to accommodate thermal expansion and contraction, preventing buckling or warping over time. Use spacer tools during installation to ensure consistent gap width.

items.title: Sealants and Adhesives
items.text: Use high quality, UV-resistant sealants and adhesives specifically designed for nfc materials to ensure a durable bond and prevent moisture ingress.

items.title: Pre-drilling
items.text: Pre-drill screw holes to the appropriate diameter to prevent splitting and ensure precise screw placement.

items.title: Waterproofing
items.text: Apply a waterproof membrane or coating on the surfaces of the product against moisture ingress especially in high-humidity or coastal environments.

items.title: Ventilation
items.text: Ensure proper ventilation above the ceiling boards to allow for air circulation and prevent moisture buildup, which can lead to mold or mildew.

items.title: Support Requirements
items.text: Due to the gravitational pull, Indowud NFC boards require proper structural support tailored to the thickness and weight of the product. The substructure should be designed to bear the load effectively, considering both static and dynamic forces. This includes using adequately sized and spaced support beams or frames to distribute the weight evenly and prevent any sagging or deformation of the boards.

items.title: Support Brackets
items.text: Incorporate additional support brackets or cross members in the substructure to enhance rigidity and distribute loads more effectively.

items.title: Edge Protection
items.text: Use edge protection profiles to safeguard the nfc boards from impact damage and to provide a clean, finished look.

ceiling.closing: By meticulously following these guidelines, one can achieve a ceiling installation with Indowud nfc boards that not only meets but exceeds industry standards, ensuring longevity, stability, and an impeccable aesthetic.

nfc-textured-panels.title: NFC Textured panels
nfc-textured-panels.tagline: The magic of nature with intricate and captivating wooden grains
nfc-textured-panels.description: Indowud introduces a revolutionary line of natural fibre composites featuring stunning wooden textured designs.

nfc-flute.title: NFC Flute
nfc-flute.tagline: The perfect blend of nature's elegance and modern design
nfc-flute.description: NFC flutes offer fluting and louver solutions to cater to green architecture, fostering a harmonious relationship between human habitation and nature, paving the way for a more sustainable panelling in the louver and flute designs
nfc-flute.contactText:
Contact us for custom sizes & designs.
Dimensions may vary by ±3mm.

nfc-door.description: Seeking an eco-friendly alternative for your entryway? Look no further than Indowud NFC door. These doors combine the timeless beauty of natural wood panel. One can easily paint, polish, varnish or overlay veneer / laminate easily

nfc-frame.title: NFC Frame
nfc-frame.woodGrainText: Also available in wood grain finish
nfc-frame.description: Indowud NFC Frames boast open grains akin to natural wood, offering a canvas for your creativity to flourish. You may stain these door frames perfectly to match your doors. Whether it's a rich, dark veneer color or a gentle hue of laminates.

nfc-siding.title: NFC Siding
nfc-siding.introText: Indowud NFC siding are unique reversible panels that can be used in both sides. One side features a regular groove, while the reverse side showcases a V-groove - enabling dual-use functionality based for wall panelling and ceiling applications.
nfc-siding.supportBoxTitle: Support : A tubular metal required at every 450mm (18 inches)
nfc-siding.supportBoxText:
Screws : for exteriors, stainless steel screws are suggested, pre drill the panel before screwing
Finishing : Can be stained, varnished, polished, painted. Available in one side or both side wooden grain patterns
Leave a 3mm - 4mm gap on the linear side for expansion / contraction.
nfc-siding.directFixText: Can be fixed directly on smooth surface

nfc-fence.description: Indowud fences offer a beautiful and eco-friendly alternative to traditional wood fencing. Strong, durable, and weather-resistant, they are perfect for any outdoor space.

nfc-flooring.title: NFC Flooring
nfc-flooring.description: Indowud NFC Flooring offers decking, porch flooring and deck tiles. Engineered for outdoor performance, it delivers natural wood aesthetics with superior slip resistance, dimensional stability, and long-term durability—designed for seamless integration into contemporary architectural landscapes
nfc-flooring.supportBoxText:
Support : Tubular metal sub-structure required at every 450 mm (18 inch) for low-traffic areas and 300 mm (12 inch) for high-traffic areas.
Ensure to apply solvent or epoxy based sealer/primer on both the surfaces before fixing.
Ensure a gap of 3-4mm on the linear side of NFC Flooring
nfc-flooring.contactText: Contact us for custom length. Ask for 300mm x 300mm deck tile in custom design.

nfc-rafters.title: NFC Rafters
nfc-rafters.description: Indowud NFC Rafters bring sculpted elegance to architectural facades, ceilings and pergolas. Precision-engineered for exposed use, they offer refined wood like aesthetics with superior stability, weather resistance, and enduring strength—creating timeless spaces where structure becomes a design statement.
nfc-rafters.supportTitle: Support : Tubular metal support at every 600mm (2 feet) - 900mm (3 feet) is suggested depending on external factors and size of the rafter

nfc-alu-clad-rafters.title: NFC Alu Clad rafters
nfc-alu-clad-rafters.description: Indowud NFC Alu Clad Rafters are custom-fabricated to size, featuring an aluminium core wrapped in Indowud NFC for natural wood aesthetics. Engineered for exposed applications, they deliver structural stability, moisture resistance, and precise architectural detailing.
nfc-alu-clad-rafters.sizeDetails: Indowud NFC 6mm textured board seamlessly wrapped on available aluminum profiles.

nfc-jaali.title: NFC Jaali
nfc-jaali.tagline: Elevate your space with intricate patterns
nfc-jaali.description1: A fusion of art, sustainability and strength. Our CNC routed NFC boards make stunning mashrabia screens, enhance interiors and lighten the weight of building exteriors.
nfc-jaali.description2: NFC jaalis are fully customizable in pattern and scale, they transform elevations into signature statements while staying true to our ahimsa-driven sustainability promise.
nfc-jaali.imageCaption: Image of Indowud NFC Jaali used in Nagpur

nfc-glu.title: NFC GLU
nfc-glu.description: NFC-GLU extends a strong water-resistant bond with almost all surfaces whether rough or smooth, porous or non-porous. We strongly recommend to use NFC-GLU with Indowud NFC for bonding different surfaces together and faster.
